body:
## Decision

`PROPOSED`: approve the exact embedded-auditor model identifier `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` when invoked through AGY with explicit model-selection and no-fallback evidence.

## Why

The canonical proof schema already allows `auditor_tool: "agy"` and the backward-compatible generic model value `gemini`, but it cannot currently record the exact Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview model used by AGY. This blocks exact-model provenance and forces lossy proof.

## Scope

- Add `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` to the canonical `embedded_audit.auditor_model` enum.
- Document AGY + Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview as an approved Tier-1 route when exact invocation and model selection are proven.
- Add regression tests for the exact approved identifier, rejection of a near-match, and backward compatibility of generic `gemini`.
- Add a bounded task packet and implementation notes.

## Explicitly out of scope

- No GitHub Actions workflow changes.
- No Google/AGY credentials, OAuth state, cookies, tokens, or keyring material in CI.
- No signer, local-attestation, PR Steward, or verdict-rule changes.
- No mutation of PR #1150.

The intended operational path is the existing exact-head signed local-attestation route for locally authenticated AGY runs.

## Bootstrap rule

This admission PR must be audited under the schema currently trusted on `main`:

- `auditor_tool: "agy"`
- `auditor_model: "gemini"`
- exact invocation and audit report prove `agy --model gemini-3.1-pro-preview --print ...`
- captured evidence must show no fallback

After merge, later proofs may use `auditor_model: "gemini-3.1-pro-preview"` directly. The new enum cannot bootstrap its own approval.

## Changed files

- `schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json`
- `docs/ops/embedded-audit.md`
- `docs/ops/embedded-audit-proof.md`
- `tests/audit/test_agy_gemini31_model.py`
- `task-packets/TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001.json`
- `proof/TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001/implementation-notes.md`

## Validation state

### OBSERVED

- Branch is based on `main` SHA `414c7ac7f998d6eaec7cf7ae9ab431c0fac6476d`.
- Diff is limited to the six allowlisted files above.
- No workflow, credential, signer, or PR Steward files changed.

### NOT_RUN / blocking

- `python -m json.tool schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json`
- `python -m pytest tests/audit/test_audit_proof.py tests/audit/test_agy_gemini31_model.py -q`
- scoped documentation validation
- `git diff --check`
- `agy --version`
- `agy models`
- exact `agy --model gemini-3.1-pro-preview --print ...` audit invocation
- independent audit bound to final code head
- PR Steward final readiness

## Merge gate

Keep draft until tests, local AGY exact-model evidence, independent audit, required CI, and PR Steward are all current-head green.
